name: Smart Translate
description: Detects source language with a bundled ML Kit model and translates on-device with managed offline language models.

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.attribution: Google ML Kit Translation and Language Identification APIs

release_notes: Replaces the Play Services-delivered Language ID model with the bundled ML Kit Language ID implementation. The model is included in generated Pro host resources, avoiding first-use optional-module downloads. Translation language models remain on-demand and user-managed.
